item_short_desc: Prepare for intense rainfalls with Rothco's Reversible PVC Poncho. Crafted from heavy-gauge PVC material, these rain ponchos are durable and reliable, ensuring you stay dry in the toughest of environments. The reversible poncho features a drawstring hood and secure snap closures for added protection from the elements. The reversible design consists of a interior for additional visibility in emergency situations. These outdoor ponchos are perfect for bug out bags, camping, or hiking packs.
